jobs.prompt:
Add a `test:stress` npm script and a small runner that reproduces the load conditions behind the g-24a1587a flake fixes (owner rule: root-cause fixes, no retries, no skips, no longer timeouts).

Create tools/stress-tests.mjs (new file) and add exactly one script to package.json: "test:stress": "node tools/stress-tests.mjs". Do not change any other script or field.

The runner runs the previously load-flaky test files repeatedly with elevated concurrency, using the required isolate import:
  node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=600000 --test-concurrency=<C> <files...>
Files: tests/concurrency-guard.test.mjs, tests/handbuild-hook-hardening.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-m2.test.mjs, tests/local-lane-review.test.mjs, tests/lane-health-core.test.mjs, tests/lane-health-persist.test.mjs, tests/server-restart-round4.test.mjs, tests/cpu-runner.test.mjs.

Defaults: rounds 5, concurrency 8. Env overrides: STRESS_ROUNDS, STRESS_CONCURRENCY. Fail fast on the first non-zero exit (no retries). Print one line per round: 'stress round <i>/<N> (concurrency <C>): pass|fail (<ms> ms)'. On failures, print the child's stdout/stderr (tail, at most 200 lines each) and exit 1. On success print 'test:stress: N rounds passed'. Keep the file small (no dependencies, node: builtins only), resolve the repo root from import.meta.url so it works from any cwd, and never write inside .swarm/.

Verify before you finish: STRESS_ROUNDS=1 STRESS_CONCURRENCY=4 npm run test:stress prints the round line and 'test:stress: 1 rounds passed' with exit code 0. Report the exact commands and outputs in your summary.
